title: Notes on the Apocalypse
author: David Steele

authorInfo.bio: David Steele (1803–1887) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Notes on the Apocalypse" by David Steele is a theological treatise written in the late 19th century that explores the Book of Revelation in the New Testament. The author, a Presbyterian pastor, aims to interpret the prophetic and symbolical language found in the Apocalypse, while providing insights and criticisms of previously established interpretations by other scholars.
